en_title: James Gunn Says It 'Won't Be Too Long' Before DCU Batman Is Cast, Will Be Close in Age to David Corenswet's Superman
cn_title: 古恩：DCU蝙蝠侠选角不远了
subtitle: 选演员，不只选明星
opus_summary: 詹姆斯·古恩透露，DCU蝙蝠侠即将启动选角，并否认演员已定的传闻。他希望选择最适合角色的演员，人选可能与超人演员年龄相近，曾出演其他DC电影也不影响入选。

paragraphs.en: James Gunn has revealed that DC Studios is finally getting ready to cast the DCU's Batman.
paragraphs.cn: 詹姆斯·古恩透露，DC影业终于准备为DCU的蝙蝠侠挑选演员了。

paragraphs.en: Speaking on a new podcast about James Gunn's Suicide Squad film, the director and DC Studios boss addressed where he's at when it comes to the next Batman. Although Robert Pattinson is playing the current caped crusader, it's expected that he will exist in his own separate universe , away from James Gunn's DCU, while another Batman will join forces with the likes of Superman.
paragraphs.cn: 在一期围绕自己执导的《X特遣队：全员集结》展开的新播客节目中，导演兼DC影业负责人詹姆斯·古恩谈到了下一任蝙蝠侠的选角进展。虽然目前蝙蝠侠由罗伯特·帕丁森饰演，但预计他仍将属于独立宇宙，与古恩的DCU分开；另一位蝙蝠侠则将与超人等角色并肩作战。

paragraphs.en: He noted that it "won't be too long" before they begin casting the next Batman and debunked rumors that he's already been cast. He noted that he's open to casting anyone for the role, even if they've been in a previous DC movie like The Suicide Squad.
paragraphs.cn: 古恩表示，他们「用不了多久」就会开始为下一任蝙蝠侠选角，同时否认了演员已经敲定的传闻。他表示，任何人都有机会出演这个角色，即使对方曾出演《X特遣队：全员集结》等DC电影，也不会被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: "When we do cast the DCU Batman, which isn't very far away, if I gave someone a day role in Suicide Squad that is going to be the best Batman, then I am not going to rule him out from that. I want to get everyone into account. One of the things that excites me about casting is being able to pick a Batman that is actually the best actor for that role. Supermans have always been chosen on who the best actor for that role is. And for some reason, Batmans are always chosen as movie stars."
paragraphs.cn: 「我们离为DCU蝙蝠侠选角已经不远了。到时候，如果最适合演蝙蝠侠的人曾在《X特遣队：全员集结》里演过一个只需拍一天的小角色，我也不会因此排除他。我想把所有人都纳入考虑。选角让我兴奋的一点，就是能挑出真正最适合蝙蝠侠这个角色的演员。超人一直都是按谁最适合这个角色来选的。但不知为什么，蝙蝠侠的人选却总是电影明星。」

paragraphs.en: Gunn also noted that he is taking age into account for the role, and stated that whoever they go with will likely be around the same age as David Corenswet, who plays Superman. He noted that the two characters are pals and contemporaries, which means they can't be too far apart in age. As a result, you can likely expect the next Batman to be in their low to mid-30s, which has historically been the sweet spot for the role, minus Ben Affleck, who was playing an older version of the character.
paragraphs.cn: 古恩还表示，他也会考虑演员的年龄，最终人选很可能与饰演超人的David Corenswet年龄相近。他指出，这两个角色既是好友，也是同龄人，因此年龄不能相差太大。所以，下一任蝙蝠侠的演员很可能在三十岁出头到三十五岁左右。以往出演这个角色的演员大多也处于这一理想年龄段，本·阿弗莱克除外，他饰演的是年纪更大的蝙蝠侠。

paragraphs.en: As of right now, it remains to be seen who will get the job. Batman is a beloved character and one that a lot of actors would love to take a crack at. Gunn also recently noted that Batman is one of the three main characters for DC's future , as one would expect. Some were hoping the role would go to Alan Ritchson, but the actor confirmed he's been having conversations with the studio about a non-Batman role, and DC Studios boss Peter Safran recently revealed they're trying to find a good character for him to play. As Gunn noted though, it could be someone we're not as familiar with. That worked out wonderfully with David Corenswet, who plays a great version of the Man of Steel. If casting is expected to begin soon, we may know who the next Batman is next year.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，谁能拿下这个角色仍未可知。蝙蝠侠深受喜爱，许多演员都想尝试出演。古恩最近也表示，蝙蝠侠是DC未来的三大主要角色之一，这一点并不令人意外。有些人希望由Alan Ritchson出演，但他已确认，自己一直在与片方洽谈另一个并非蝙蝠侠的角色。DC影业负责人Peter Safran最近也透露，他们正在努力为他寻找合适的角色。不过，正如古恩所说，最终人选也可能是我们不太熟悉的演员。David Corenswet就是一个非常成功的例子，他塑造的超人十分出色。如果选角如预期般很快启动，我们或许明年就能知道谁是下一任蝙蝠侠。
